title: New Sweetheart
author: Linda Leslie
problems: Row 6 "star left 4 places" can't start from where the dancers are: A star of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
Row 7 "partners balance & swing · swing" can't start from where the dancers are: A swing that ends facing across must start nearer one side.
The progression after row 7 "partners balance & swing · swing" doesn't work out: Couple 2 must face the same way to find new neighbors.
Row 1 "long lines forward & back" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 0 is not standing in a side line.
Row 2 "mad robins, larks in front" can't start from where the dancers are: A mad robin needs two dancers on each side line, one above the other.
Row 3 "circle left 3 places" can't start from where the dancers are: A circle of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
Row 4 "neighbors swing" can't start from where the dancers are: A swing that ends facing across must start nearer one side.
Row 5 "right diagonal robins chain" can't start from where the dancers are: No couples face each other on the right diagonal.
choices: A balance with a partner or neighbor holds both hands.
A star with no grip named is a basket star (wrist grip).
